meaning:
ἐκούσιος, -ον
(έκών), [in LXX chiefly for נְדָבָה, as Num.15:3 (κατ᾽ ἑ) ;]
usually of actions, voluntary: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
